content.title: Before you fly
content.subtitle: Falling sick in a new country is the most stressful thing.

steps.title: Full checkup
steps.detail: A doctor, dentist and eye checkup before you go. These can be expensive there.

steps.title: Medicines and prescription
steps.detail: Carry a stock of regular medicines and the doctor's prescription. Check the rules first.

steps.title: Understand your insurance
steps.detail: Read once what the policy covers and what it doesn't. Also how claims work.
steps.tip: Fly & Settle helps with travel and health insurance.

steps.title: Vaccination record
steps.detail: Keep all records in one folder, scanned too. Your university may ask for them.

steps.title: Emergency contacts
steps.detail: Local emergency number, university health centre and home number. On your phone and on paper.

caption:
Before the flight, prepare your health too. Do these 5 things 👇

1. Full checkup
2. Medicines and prescription
3. Understand your insurance
4. Vaccination record
5. Emergency contacts

Save this 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.
